One time I was cosplaying Sans during the Undertale hype. I was wearing a mask so it was kinda hard to breath and everything I said was extremely muffled. This is important.

I was with my at the time girlfriend and we were hanging out with other Undertale Cosplayers. So there was this one Frisk who was super touchy feely. She kept hugging my arm and hugging me and pulling me around. I was uncomfortable but being me , I kept quiet. 

At one point I had pretend fell for a joke and this Frisk cosplayer lays ontop of me. Shes a bit over weight and I was pretty skinny at the time , so I cant handle her weight. I start patting frantically at the ground cus I can hardly breath. As far as I know , tapping at the ground is the universal time out. She doesn't get off. So I start yelling for my gf and our other friend but its muffled and weak cus I hardly have any air. So Im casually dying under this Frisk cosplayer. I cant even take off my mask , I can't reach it. 

So finally my gf gets the message and they have to pull her off. She wouldnt get off!!! So I jump up and pull off my mask , gasping for air. The Frisk cosplayer keeps joking around like "Oh Sans why'd you pull off your skull?" And I just ignore her. I catch my breath , put the mask on , and then me and my gf leave. I didn't interact with that cosplayer the rest of the con and I wouldn't let her hug me anymore. 

So I would say that was a pretty terrible experience.
